name: Sword
description: Sword wielders have high Agility, allowing them to dart across the battlefield and overwhelm their foes with rapid, precise strikes.

archetypes.name: Hero
archetypes.description: With shining sword and shield, lead the front line and inspire your allies.
archetypes.playstyle:
Use your sword and shield to stand at the front and strike enemies. If you generate Bonus Momentum from attacking with your sword, use Swift Task (reduced thanks to Sword Adept) to strike again. Then, choose different Minor actions:
* Use the **Block** Minor Action (enhanced by Shield Master) to defend either yourself or an ally.
* Use **Console** as a Minor Action on allies who have lost Willpower.
* Use **Rally** as a Minor action to help an ally succeed.

archetypes.name: Twinblade
archetypes.description: Dual wield swords with dizzying speed and careful footwork.
archetypes.playstyle:
While dual-wielding shortswords, after attacking once with one shortsword you can **always Swift Task to attack with the other**, at no Momentum cost (Sword Adept + Dual Wielding talents reduce the normal cost after attacking to 0). 

 **Skirmisher** punishes enemies who fail to hit you with opportunity attacks - later levels of Skirmisher make this more reliable. 

 **Swift Steps** allows you to immediately Swift Task after taking the Sprint Action (by granting the 2 Momentum needed to Swift Task), useful for Sprinting into position and striking once with a sword. Be weary about running into danger though, you can quickly get surrounded and defeated if separated from your allies.

archetypes.name: Spellsword
archetypes.description: Weave Arcane Magick through every strike of your blade.
archetypes.playstyle:
Thanks to **Spellblade**, you can cast spells at no detriment by wielding just your sword in hand. Weave in sword attacks with ranged spells such as **Frigid Grasp**. 

 Augment your sword strikes by casting **Thunderous Strike** or **Volcanic Strike** before you attack. Get out of (and into) danger by casting **Skip** - remember that it has an increased range thanks to your **Warp** talent. 
 When attacked by weapons you aren't the best at defending with you can use **Arcane Parry** to defend with your high Reason.

archetypes.name: Assassin
archetypes.description: A shadowy killer who strikes from hiding with blade and throwing knife before vanishing without a trace.
archetypes.playstyle:
Open a fight from range by throwing your Throwing Knife - a successful hit with **Thrown Weapons Adept** hands you a bonus momentum immediately. Close in and strike with your shortsword or dagger; **Sword Adept** and **Dual Wielding** both shave down the cost to Swift Task into a second attack with whichever blade is free, letting you chain hits before the enemy can react.

Once you've landed a hit, use **Stealthy Fighter** to Hide as a Minor Action - vanish back into the shadows to reposition, line up your next throw, or avoid being ganged up on between turns.

name: Axe
description: Axe wielders have high Brawn, cleaving through enemies with raw, relentless power.

archetypes.name: Death Knight
archetypes.description: A dark, battle-scarred fighter who channels forbidden magick through a brutal axe, feeding on the pain they deal.
archetypes.playstyle:
Make your battleaxe your **Spellblade** weapon, so you can swing it using Presence instead of Brawn - and cast Dark spells right through it, no Spell Implement needed. Before charging in, cast **Siphoning Strike** to imbue your axe: the extra damage lands alongside your **Axe Adept** rerolls, and you heal for every Effect you roll.

When an enemy manages to wound you, retaliate on your next turn - **Vengeful** grants a hefty 2 bonus momentum against anyone who damaged you this round, fueling repeat swings or a follow-up **Soul Drain** to seep away more of their life for your own.

archetypes.name: Guardian
archetypes.description: An unshakeable protector who plants themselves between allies and danger, shielding the vulnerable from harm.
archetypes.playstyle:
Take the Guard Major Action to protect an ally - wearing armor nets you a bonus momentum from **Defensive Wall** for doing so, and **Close Protection** lets that ally move freely at your side without leaving your protection, keeping them shielded as the fight shifts.

Wield your round shield to Block incoming attacks: **Shield Master** doubles the temporary HP you gain when an Effect is rolled. Once per session, designate an ally with **Willing Shield** so you can throw yourself between them and an attacker's blow, assisting their defense with your own weapon's Attribute and Skirmish.

archetypes.name: Warrior
archetypes.description: A relentless frontline bruiser that can enter a battle frenzy and strikes with devestaing blows of a greataxe.
archetypes.playstyle:
Thanks to **Heavy Lifting**, wield your greataxe in one hand without penalty so you can also carry your shield - the best of both offense and defense. Go berserk as a Minor Action with **Berserker**: you gain a bonus die and +2[CD] on every melee swing, and **Axe Adept** lets you reroll any damage dice that come up low.

Before the real fighting starts, **Antagonist** makes your Demoralize hit twice as hard, softening an enemy's resolve before you close the distance. Remember that while berserk you can't recover HP or Willpower and enemies gain a bonus die against you too - so pick your moment to rage.

archetypes.name: Reaver
archetypes.description: A fast and dangerous dual-wielder who tears through the battlefield with an axe in each hand.
archetypes.playstyle:
**Heavy Lifting** lets you wield your greataxe in a single hand, freeing your other hand for a handaxe - true dual-wielding of two Axe-tag weapons. Attack with one, then use **Dual Wielding**'s reduced Swift Task cost to follow up with the other; **Axe Adept** lets you reroll any lackluster damage dice from either strike.

When you Shove a foe out of position, **Juggernaut** sends them flying 3 spaces instead of 1 - useful for putting distance between you and a target you'd rather isolate, or knocking someone off a ledge or into a hazard.

name: Spear
description: Spear wielders have high Coordination, striking with precision and reach to keep foes at bay or run them through from horseback.

archetypes.name: Cavalier
archetypes.description: Well armored atop a trusty steed, charge ahead and through your foes.
archetypes.playstyle:
Gallop ahead with your steed's high speed to get to where you need to be. Thanks to **Spear Adept** you can strike reliably with your Lance. That, combined with the bonus momentum **Cavalry Adept** gives, you can often Swift Task to strike again if the first attack landed well. Lock down the position of enemies by making sure your Opportunity Attacks land using **Opportunist.**

For the one enemy on the field you swear to defeat, you can initiate a Duel with **Duelist**, striking them multiple times and dealing extra damage using even more bonus momentum.

archetypes.name: Cataphract
archetypes.description: A heavily armored rider wielding a massive polearm that controls the battlefield.
archetypes.playstyle: Stand as a vanguard in front of your allies, punishing enemies that try to move past the immense range of your pike with enhanced Opportunity Attacks thanks to **Impenetrable** and **Opportunist**. Ride ahead and attack enemies with your great reach - though you should not separate too far from allies who could use your protection.

archetypes.name: Paladin
archetypes.description: A holy knight in shining armor, smiting enemies and blessing allies through the will of heaven.
archetypes.playstyle:
Make your glaive your **Spellblade** weapon so you can strike with Faith instead of Coordination, and cast Light spells through it freely. Before wading in, cast **Holy Smite** to imbue the blade with radiant power, then thrust with **Spear Adept**'s bonus die backing up the swing.

At the start of a rough turn, take a **Defensive Stance** for 5 temporary HP to weather the return blow. Between clashes, reach out with **Lay on Hands** to mend a wounded ally at your side, ward one with **Divine Protection** from range, or soften a target with **Guiding Ray** so your allies' follow-up attacks land easier.

archetypes.name: Bulwark
archetypes.description: An unyielding shield-bearer who plants themselves at the front line, guarding allies from harm.
archetypes.playstyle:
Plant yourself at the front with your tower shield - its Concealing quality gives adjacent allies Half-Cover from ranged attacks, while **Shield Master** doubles the temporary HP your Block gains from a rolled Effect. Take the Guard Major Action to watch over an ally: **Defensive Wall** rewards you with bonus momentum for wearing armor while you do, and **Close Protection** lets your ward move freely at your side without stepping outside your protection.

When an opening appears, thrust with your spear - **Spear Adept**'s bonus die keeps your strikes reliable even while your attention is split between offense and holding the line.

name: Bow
description: Bow wielders have high Awareness, striking foes from range with unerring precision before they can close the distance.

archetypes.name: Heavy Bowman
archetypes.description: A versatile skirmisher who makles powerful shots from a longbow, fighting dirty when the odds demand it.
archetypes.playstyle:
**Aim** before striking with your bow whenever you can. Choose your first target in a fight carefully, as you can inflict Slowed on them on a hit.

You can duck into hiding easily with **Stealthy Fighter**: Aim, Attack, then depending on how much Bonus Momentum you generate you can Move and then Hide. You have a lot of health, so if your allies are suffering out in the open it may be wise to make yourself a target by not hiding as much later into a fight, and use your Axes to survive in melee.

archetypes.name: Outrider
archetypes.description: A mounted scout who hunts prey from horseback, striking from range with a bow or skewering foes with a lance at full gallop.
archetypes.playstyle: Attack nearly any enemy on the field with the immense speed of your mount and range of your bow. You have the armor and HP needed to survive behind enemy lines briefly; make use of this to eliminate targets on the other end of the battlefield before galloping back to safety. Swap to your Lance when surrounded by enemies in melee.

archetypes.name: Ranger
archetypes.description: A resourceful hunter who tracks foes with a keen eye, striking from afar and patching up allies between skirmishes.
archetypes.playstyle:
Mark enemies for death by Pinpointing them with a Major Action - and immediately use the Bonus Momentum from **Tactician** to Swift Task and Attack with your Bow. Aim whenever you have a Minor Action to spare before shooting your Bow.

Mend the wounds of your allies or yourself with your high Medicine skills and extra Healing Potion you have on hand, and search for hidden targets with your heightened Search range from **Hunter Seeker**.

archetypes.name: Arcane Archer
archetypes.description: A scholarly marksman who weaves Arcane Magick into every arrow, striking from range with elemental force.
archetypes.playstyle:
Thanks to **Spellshot**, your Spellblade spells work through your bow instead of a melee weapon - imbue your shortbow with **Volcanic Strike**, **Frozen Strike**, or **Thunderous Strike** before firing to layer elemental damage and a status effect onto your shot. **Bow Adept** lets you choose the better result when you reroll on the Aim Minor Action, keeping your aimed shots reliable.

Use **Skip** to reposition - **Warp** extends its range further than most, letting you put real distance between yourself and anyone closing in. When forced into melee, **Arcane Parry** lets you defend with Magick instead of your physical Attributes.

name: Arcane Magick
description: Arcane Magick practitioners have high Reason, bending reality itself to unleash devastating and versatile spells.

archetypes.name: Fulgermancer
archetypes.description: A quick, elusive mage who strikes with lightning and blinks past danger, vanishing before enemies can retaliate.
archetypes.playstyle:
Strike from range with **Electric Arc**, then use **Fulgermancer** to juice up your next Lightning spell - Arcing Bolt to catch multiple foes in its burst, Distant Spark to stretch your range further, or Static Vulnerability to leave a stunned target wide open for an ally's follow-up. **Armis Arcane** keeps you surprisingly durable while unarmored and unshielded.

When things get too close, cast **Invisibilis** and immediately Hide as a free action thanks to **Shadow Cloak** - or **Skip** away entirely, **Warp** stretching the teleport further than most casters manage. Either way, you're gone before retaliation ever lands.

archetypes.name: Pyromancer
archetypes.description: A mounted battlemage who scorches the battlefield with searing fire and cunning arcane tricks.
archetypes.playstyle:
Ride into range on your horse - **Cavalry Adept** removes the usual Difficulty increase for casting while mounted - and rain down **Firebolt** on your enemies. Apply **Pyromancer** to your next Fire spell for Spreading Flames to catch a cluster of foes, Vicious Flames for a straight damage boost, or Distant Flames to strike from further away.

With your Spell Implement in hand, **Augmentier** turns any Bonus Damage momentum spend into extra damage dice instead of flat points, letting a well-placed hit spiral out of control. Use **Skip** to reposition and **Electric Arc** to punish anyone resistant to fire, and fall back on **Arcane Parry** to defend with Magick if an enemy closes the distance.

archetypes.name: Cryomancer
archetypes.description: A hardy battlemage who chills foes to the bone and shields themselves in a ward of ice.
archetypes.playstyle:
Stay unarmored and shieldless to get the most from **Counterspell** - a bonus, rerollable die to defend against enemy spells - while **Armis Arcane** still grants you 2 Resistance to offset the risk. Freeze foes at range with **Frigid Grasp**, then apply **Cryomancer** to your next Ice spell: Encasing Ice to lock a Slowed target down entirely, Frostbite to catch them Off-Guard instead, or Brittle Ice to expose them to your allies' attacks.

With your Spell Implement in hand, **Augmentier** converts Bonus Damage momentum spends into extra damage dice. If an enemy gets in your face, imbue your handaxe with **Frozen Strike** to slow them down, or **Skip** away before they get the chance.

archetypes.name: Spellstalker
archetypes.description: A cunning infiltrator who slips past enemies unseen, striking from the shadows with blade and Arcane Magick.
archetypes.playstyle:
Strike from hiding with **Electric Arc** or **Frozen Strike**, then use **Stealthy Fighter** to Hide again as a Minor Action the moment your attack connects. Cast **Invisibilis** to vanish outright - **Shadow Cloak** lets you immediately Hide as a free action the instant you turn invisible, layering concealment on concealment.

When you need to close distance or bail out entirely, **Skip** away with **Warp**'s extended range. Your buckler's Effortless quality keeps your off-hand free without slowing you down, so you're never caught without an escape route.

name: Light Magick
description: Light Magick practitioners have high Faith, channeling divine power to heal allies and ward off harm.

archetypes.name: Mendicant
archetypes.description: A holy healer who channels Light Magick to mend the wounded and shield the faithful.
archetypes.playstyle:
Reach out and heal the wounded with **Lay on Hands**, then apply **Vitalurge** to your next Healing spell - Soothing Touch for more HP restored, Restorative Ward to layer on temporary HP, or Cleansing Light to burn off a lingering condition alongside the healing. **Divine Protection** wards an ally before they take a hit at all, and **Guiding Ray** both damages a foe and makes them easier for your allies to hit.

With your Spell Implement in hand, **Augmentier** turns Bonus Damage momentum into extra dice to roll for your healing and attack spells alike.

archetypes.name: Luminary
archetypes.description: A radiant vessel of Heaven's will, mending allies and channeling searing divine on the battlefield.
archetypes.playstyle:
Strike from range with **Guiding Ray**, then apply **Luminurge** to your next Radiant spell to layer on a status effect - Dazzling Flash to catch them Off-Guard, Weakening Glare to sap their strength, or Exposing Glint to open them up for your allies. **Touch of Haste** sends an ally darting into position or out of danger with a burst of speed.

Mend the wounded with **Lay on Hands**, and with your Spell Implement in hand, **Augmentier** turns Bonus Damage momentum into extra damage dice on the rare occasion you need to hit hard. **Fortified Mind** lets you shrug off attempts to shake your resolve mid-fight.

archetypes.name: Inquisitor
archetypes.description: A relentless hunter of heretics and mages, striking down the unfaithful with holy fire and cutting words.
archetypes.playstyle:
Use **Inquisitor's Eye** to sniff out anyone hiding from you, then bear down on spellcasters especially - **Mage's Bane** lets you punish an enemy the instant they cast a spell, either with an immediate Opportunity Attack if they're close or a full-speed charge to close the gap if they're not. Imbue your shortsword with **Holy Smite** before you strike.

Demoralize is your other weapon: **Antagonist** adds extra damage to a successful Demoralize, and **Provocateur** lets you tack the Provoking damage effect onto either your attack or your Demoralize, dragging an enemy's attention onto you. **Castigate** batters a target's Willpower directly, softening their resolve from range before you ever close in.

archetypes.name: War Priest
archetypes.description: A devout warrior who smashes foes with a blessed warhammer while channeling Light Magick to heal and protect.
archetypes.playstyle:
Make your warhammer your **Spellblade** weapon, striking with Faith instead of Brawn and casting Light spells through it without a Spell Implement. Imbue it with **Holy Smite** before you swing - your warhammer's own Knockdown effect on top of the extra radiant damage can flatten an enemy outright.

**Mage's Bane** lets you punish enemy spellcasters the moment they cast, with an Opportunity Attack if they're close or a full charge if they're not. Between swings, mend allies with **Lay on Hands**, soften a target from range with **Guiding Ray** or **Castigate**, and use **Luminurge** to layer a status effect onto your next Radiant spell.

name: Dark Magick
description: Dark Magick practitioners have high Presence, wielding shadow and fear to weaken foes and slip through the battlefield unseen.

archetypes.name: Shadow Caller
archetypes.description: A shadowy trickster who cloaks themselves in darkness, striking from the unseen and unraveling the minds of their foes.
archetypes.playstyle:
Strike from range with **Penumbra**, then apply **Noctocraft** to your next Shadow spell - Grip of Terror to leave a hit target Frightened, Enfeebling Shroud to set up a devastating follow-up Demoralize, or Last Will to hit even harder once you've taken a Wound yourself. Imbue your dagger with **Shadow Blade** or **Geist Strike** before closing in for the kill.

Disappear the instant the fighting turns against you: **Stealthy Fighter** lets you Hide as a Minor Action right after a successful attack, and casting **Umbral Shroud** turns you invisible outright - **Shadow Cloak** then lets you Hide again immediately, keeping you one step ahead of anyone trying to find you.

archetypes.name: Plague Doctor
archetypes.description: A grim physician who turns blood and sickness into a weapon, cursing enemies while keeping allies standing.
archetypes.playstyle:
Poison a foe's blood with **Blood Sickness**, then apply **Hemocraft** to your next Blood spell - Open Veins to make them harder to heal, Diseased Blood to worsen the lingering damage, or Blood Sense to stretch your reach. **Soul Drain** seeps away an enemy's life force at close range and hands the stolen HP right back to you.

When an ally goes down, **Combat Medic** gives you a bonus die on First Aid even in the thick of a fight, and **Blood Heal** lets you trade your own HP to mend theirs at a steep exchange rate. With your Spell Implement in hand, **Augmentier** turns Bonus Damage momentum into extra damage dice for when you need to strike back yourself.

archetypes.name: Nosferatu
archetypes.description: A predatory creature of the night who beguiles their prey before draining their very soul.
archetypes.playstyle:
Seep away life with **Soul Drain**, then apply **Thymocraft** to your next Soul spell - Weakening Drain to sap a target's strength, Lethargic Drain to slow them down, or Thirsting Drain to heal for even more when the spell restores your HP. **Siphoning Strike** turns your handaxe itself into a life-draining weapon for when enemies close the distance.

**Gremorie** gives your Tome an extra Spell Slot, letting you prepare more of your draining spells than most casters manage, and **Augmentier** converts Bonus Damage momentum into extra damage dice with your Spell Implement in hand.

archetypes.name: Night Rider
archetypes.description: A mounted lancer who rides down foes and strikes at their soul with the power of Dark Magick.
archetypes.playstyle:
Charge in mounted, lance leveled - its Saddleback quality means you don't suffer the usual Difficulty increase for attacking on horseback, and **Spear Adept** adds a reliable bonus die to the strike. Make your lance your **Spellblade** weapon so you can attack with Presence and cast Dark spells through it without a Spell Implement.

Before the charge, cast **Penumbra** or imbue your lance with **Shadow Blade** for extra bite, and apply **Noctocraft** to your next Shadow spell to leave a hit target Frightened. **Blood Bargain** lets you trade HP for a burst of Willpower (or an easier Magick task) when you need the extra push, and **Siphoning Strike** keeps you topped up in a drawn-out melee.

name: Authority
description: Authority archetypes have high Presence, leading allies from the front and turning the tide of battle through command and inspiration rather than the blade alone.

archetypes.name: Bishop
archetypes.description: A commanding priest who leads from horseback, blending Light Magick and authority to guide the faithful in battle.
archetypes.playstyle:
Ride at the head of your allies - **Cavalry Adept** removes the usual Difficulty increase for acting from horseback - and take the **Direct** Major Action to let an ally act on your turn. **Commander** grants a bonus momentum every time you Direct or Issue Orders, and **Bannerlord** lets you wield your banner without tying up a hand, still granting a reroll on Authority Tasks or Direct itself.

Support from range with **Guiding Ray** to soften a foe and set up an ally's attack, mend wounds with **Lay on Hands**, and use **Prayer of Fortune** to hand an ally an Advantage right when they need it most.

archetypes.name: Lord
archetypes.description: A frontline leader whose presence alone can turn the tide, rallying allies with authority and a rapier's precision.
archetypes.playstyle:
Stand in the fray and allow your allies to act on your turn by taking the **direct** Major Action.

Or, strike with your rapier with precision - wielding only a buckler in your other hand allows you reroll one d20 on each of your attacks. Thanks to **Rapier Adept** you gain a free Minor Action to use when you attack, such as to restore an ally's Willpower using **Console** or guide them on their next turn using **Rally**.

archetypes.name: Strategist
archetypes.description: A calculating tactician who sets traps, reads the battlefield, and directs allies to strike at the perfect moment.
archetypes.playstyle:
Set the battlefield before the fight even starts - **Trapper** lets you lay hidden Spring, Steel, or Net traps to knock back, immobilize, or ensnare anyone who stumbles into them. Open with **Pinpoint** to size up a target, and **Tactician** hands you 2 bonus momentum for it, on top of unlocking the **Direct** Major Action.

**Commander** adds another bonus momentum every time you Direct or Issue Orders, letting your allies act more often than they could alone, and **Helping Hand** does the same for a well-timed Assist. Fall back on your shortbow to pick off stragglers while your traps and orders do the heavy lifting.

archetypes.name: Dark Vizier
archetypes.description: A scheming manipulator who bends others to their will through silver words and forbidden magick.
archetypes.playstyle:
**Feint** before you strike, redirecting your next melee attack to use Intrigue instead of Skirmish - useful when your cunning outstrips your swordsmanship. Imbue your blade with **Geist Strike** to leave a hit target seeing you as Invisible, or vanish outright with **Umbral Shroud**.

**Tactician** rewards you with bonus momentum for Pinpointing a target and opens up the **Direct** Major Action, while **Helping Hand** does the same for a well-placed Assist - letting your allies strike harder and more often than they could alone. Keep a throwing knife ready for anyone who closes the distance before you're ready for them.
